best_reachable_p_this_subgrid.principle: An upper bound on what this sub-grid could EVER show, not a claim about what it did show. The prior artifact reported p=1.0, asserting no discordant pair could exist, which vc33 falsifies.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal prefix so the reconciler classifies this as complete; the body states the count rather than a mood, because 'inconclusive' alone would hide that one cell IS certified.

n_confounded_not_deconfounded.principle: 8 of the 12 grid cells still have an asset-confounded base arm. They are reported explicitly rather than dropped, so nobody reads 4 deconfounded cells as if the grid were 12.

n_missing.principle: A truncated cell is a MISSING OBSERVATION, never a zero. Counting it as a null would flatter whichever arm was slower, and slowness here tracked machine load rather than the treatment.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: Declared on every artifact that could be read as a verifier claim, so a circular win can never headline as a moat. Here there is no verifier claim.

headline: The composite pre-flight's 4 'attributable' perturbations were an ASSET confound, not the 25-commit code span -- but the correction that established this was itself certified against an invalid noise floor. Re-measured properly: 1 of 4 deconfounded cells (vc33) is a CERTIFIED code-attributable perturbation; 2 are observed nulls; 1 is a missing observation. Far short of the 6 discordant pairs alpha=0.05 needs.
load_not_assets: The earlier claim that the live assets made cells slower is NOT supported. basefix/tu93 was SIGTERM'd at the 1500s cap; basefix2/tu93, the SAME configuration, completed in 558.6s. The difference was contemporaneous machine load, which was not recorded at the time. Truncation was therefore non-random with respect to when a cell ran, which is why the truncated cells are excluded as missing observations rather than scored.

second_order_error_corrected_this_sessio.cell_relabelled: the invalid floor is preserved as basefix_noassets__vc33 -- it is a valid THIRD confirmation of the asset effect, just not a noise floor
second_order_error_corrected_this_sessio.how_it_misled: It came back byte-identical to the no-asset base arm and was read as 'vc33 fails its own noise floor', which retracted the one cell that had survived.
second_order_error_corrected_this_sessio.resolution: Assets restored and verified LOADED (live_action_effect_scorer non-None). The vc33 A/A re-measured at the correct configuration is IDENTICAL across THREE replicates (basefix, basefix2, basefix2b -- all sha 329d92ccb0, 19 actions), while the A/B still differs at index 17. vc33 is certified.
second_order_error_corrected_this_sessio.what: The correction's own A/A floor (basefixb/vc33) was invalid. The asset symlinks were removed from the worktree at 15:43:32 (both dirs carry an ns-identical mtime, i.e. one unlink batch) and that cell did not start until ~15:56, so it replicated the NO-ASSET configuration while certifying a WITH-ASSET A/B.

verifier_is_oracle_note: No verifier claim is made here. This artifact measures whether a code change moves the live agent's ACTION STREAM; it makes no moat, efficiency or value-added claim.

what_was_withdrawn.claim: 4 attributable perturbations (vc33/tn36/tr87/tu93) diverging at action indices 4/3/2/3, reported as the first positive treatment-activation signal.
what_was_withdrawn.why: The base arm was served from a git worktree and the head arm from the canonical checkout. results/experiment_4629_live_frame_change_cnn.pt and data/arc_transition_corpus/ are gitignored, so `git worktree add` did not materialise them; the base arm's load_live_action_effect_scorer() returned None, no ActionEffectExpansionPrior was built, and the search frontier expanded in a different order. That asset axis was perfectly confounded with the arm axis. The base commit ALREADY contains the scorer wiring, so it is not part of the treatment span.
what_was_withdrawn.why_no_noise_floor_could_catch_it: head/headb both ran from the canonical repo and base/baseb both from the worktree, so BOTH A/A floors held the asset axis fixed by construction. That is why 10/10 replicate pairs were IDENTICAL while every A/B perturbed.
